description: Send a short idea, correction or problem about Walkably's scores, maps or pages to the Walkably team. Use it only when the person asks to send feedback. It stores the message so the team can read it; it does not reply in the chat.

email.description: Optional: an email address, only if the person wants an answer.

message.description: The feedback itself, in the person's own words: an idea, a correction or a problem (10 to 2,000 characters).

place.description: Optional: the city, district or address the feedback is about.

name: submit_feedback
title: Send feedback to Walkably
